name: boamp-mcp
description: BOAMP (deals): search_postings, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: GET /api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/boamp/records (Opendatasoft Explore API v2.1, linked from https://www.boamp.fr/pages/api-boamp/). `query` is sent as a quoted ODSQL string literal in `where` ('a simple full-text search'), e.g. toiture vichy → where="toiture vichy"; a double quote inside the query breaks the clause (ODSQLSyntaxError). `category` refines on the descripteur_libelle facet (exact French label, e.g. Maîtrise d'oeuvre, Bâtiment, Prestations de services). Newest first (order_by dateparution desc). The dataset holds every BOAMP notice type — contract notices, award results, corrections — check raw.nature_categorise_libelle ('Avis de marché' = open call) and deadline (datelimitereponse). min_budget is not sent (no amount field). offset+limit must stay below 10000. id is the BOAMP idweb (e.g. 26-91551).

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GET /records?where=idweb="<id>"&limit=1 — the dataset's GET /records/{record_id} takes the internal record id, not the BOAMP number, so the notice is fetched by filtering on idweb. An unknown idweb returns no record (invalid_input). The full notice (eForms / legacy XML converted to JSON) is in raw.donnees and raw.gestion as JSON strings.
